estimand.name: paired complete-policy post-washout regret
estimand.carryover_control: controller reads previous block only; episode state resets; no current-block outcome enters action

hash_prng_transcript.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON sort_keys=true separators=(',',':') ensure_ascii=true allow_nan=false plus one LF
hash_prng_transcript.source_bytes: UTF-8 without BOM, exact bytes hashed, no post-hash normalization
hash_prng_transcript.digest: SHA-256 lowercase hexadecimal; digest fields decode to raw 32 bytes before framing

action_assignment.tune_assessment: locked policy argmax; exact tie applies

hash_prng_transcript.draw_policy: every declared draw is consumed once per row in ordinal order; no conditional draws, no redraws, no replay, or future-data reads

controller_transition_table.name: lagged selective-credit controller

rows.rule: reset all trajectory and pending fields; retain only fit-persistent fields
compute finite prediction and loss before any action or model write
use one pre-transition snapshot; no credit on row zero
fit uses sealed rational hash; tune and assessment use locked policy
apply exactly one SGD row update; skip writes no parameter; increment counters once
publish every field consumed by the next row; undeclared carryover rejects
credit final pending action with gamma zero; perform no model action
append exactly one canonical counter row per observed row

controller_transition_table.rhs_rule: all right-hand sides read the pre-transition snapshot and commit simultaneously
controller_transition_table.pending_rule: every pending and previous field must be read, written, or reset by an indexed row; undeclared state is invalid
controller_transition_table.terminal_rule: row 255 records loss and terminal credit only; no model action

delayed_reward_v4.equation: 32 eight-row episodes; cue cached at phase zero; reward appears at phase seven; sign flips at episode 16

event_sensor_v4.equation: three deduplicated signed events; x0 parity anchor; target sign flips at row 128

long_horizon_v4.equation: ring_buffer(x0,row-32) with target sign flip at row 128; prefill zero

generator_roster.draw_rule: each row consumes every roster entry in ordinal and repeat order; conditional semantics mask already-drawn values; redraw is forbidden

operation_and_byte_algebra.numeric_rules: IEEE-754 binary64 round-to-nearest-even; no fused multiply-add; left-to-right reductions; overflow, NaN, and infinity are fatal
operation_and_byte_algebra.operation_units: each multiply, add, subtract, compare, divide, min, max, clip, counter increment, parameter write, hash invocation, and PRNG draw is separately counted
resource_invariants: one stream row enters each update
replay bytes are zero for every declared arm
measured joules remain absent until privileged raw trace validation
operation counts, storage bytes, latency, and measured joules are separate fields

ablation_execution_multiplicity.arm_reset: zero model and controller state per arm and seed; no state crosses arms
ablation_execution_multiplicity.matched_random_rule: probability is computed from candidate fit rows before tune and then frozen; no tune-derived probability

holm_groups.name: primary_loss
holm_groups.comparisons: candidate versus fixed SGD across six families

holm_groups.name: adaptation
holm_groups.comparisons: candidate versus fixed SGD across drift, delayed_reward, event, long_horizon

ablation_execution_multiplicity.statistic: paired seed difference; two-sided erfc(abs(z)/sqrt(2)); one-sided 0.5*erfc(-z/sqrt(2)); n<2 or nonfinite variance rejects
ablation_execution_multiplicity.missing_rules: missing, nonfinite, censored, incomplete, or attrited trajectories fail closed and cannot be imputed
gate_predicates: adjusted primary p<=0.05 in at least two non-null families
candidate loss no worse in every qualifying family
candidate adaptation no worse in every shift family and strictly better in one
active operations, updates, storage, latency, and joules are non-inferior within 5 percent
pure-noise null shows no candidate advantage

adaptation_metrics.primary: mean per-seed adaptation lag after each declared generator change point
adaptation_metrics.change_points: only segment boundaries in the frozen generator roster
adaptation_metrics.baseline: median of 16 finite pre-change losses; fewer than 16 is invalid
adaptation_metrics.recovery_scan: first adjacent pair of eight-row windows [k,k+8) and [k+8,k+16) whose means are <= threshold
adaptation_metrics.censoring: if no pair before next_shift or segment end, lag=segment_end-change_point and censored=true
adaptation_metrics.aggregation: aggregate within seed then paired-test seeds; never scan across shifts or attribute later recovery to an earlier shift
adaptation_metrics.zero_nonfinite: zero baseline is valid; empty, negative, nonfinite, or missing losses reject
adaptation_metrics.minimum_effect: two-row improvement in at least one declared shift family

lock_counter_control_schemas.schema_policy: all fields required, canonical JSON bytes, unknown fields reject, self-digest excludes only its digest field

provider_receipts.signature: Ed25519 over canonical body excluding signature_hex and receipt_sha256
provider_receipts.cross_binding: same allocation_id, node_id, launch manifest digest, public key, and bounded UTC interval

energy_receipt.trace: CSV utc_ns,watts with >=2 increasing finite nonnegative rows

independent_validation.decision: accepted only when every named check is true and packet-bound

assessment_absence.rule: assessment rows, effects, and result payloads must not exist before review ACCEPT, tune lock, and separate real-execution authorization

stop_rules: stop on any source-byte, digest, schema, canonicalization, or independent-review mismatch
stop on nonfinite numeric values, overflow, undeclared state, hidden draw, replay, or accumulation
stop if review is not ACCEPT before implementation
stop if fit or tune lock is absent, noncanonical, unbound, or independently unaccepted
stop if synthetic qualification is not candidate
stop if preflight is not zero-spend, offline, bounded, and independently recorded
stop if provider allocation, cost, or stop signature fails or charged USD exceeds the hard ceiling
stop if raw joules cannot be independently recomputed from the trace
retain no_candidate unless quality, adaptation, resource, statistical, custody, and measured-energy gates pass across two real families

boundaries.givemeanode_h100: one bounded job only after no-spend preflight, positive hard USD ceiling, and operator custody
